children: South Korea’s annual inflation rate rose to 3.1% in August 2026 from 2.8% in the previous month.
The latest reading was below market expectations of 3.2%, though it climbed further above the central bank’s 2% target.
Transport inflation remained elevated at 7.2%, although it eased from 7.7% in July, as gasoline and diesel prices accelerated, while communication costs surged 16.6% (vs 0.5%).
Inflation also increased for recreation and culture (4.9% vs 5.5%), housing and utilities (1.9% vs 1.8%), and restaurants and hotels (2.8% vs 2.8%).
By contrast, food and non-alcoholic beverages prices fell 0.5% (vs 0.9%), with fresh food prices dropping 6.7%.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose by 0.2% in July, falling short of market estimates for a 0.3% gain but rebounding from a 0.2% decline in the preceding period.

title: South Korea Inflation Rate Accelerates in August
